note.en: Verified 2026-09-29 against NZQA 'NCEA levels and certificates'. Since 2024 each level needs 60 credits at that level or above, PLUS a separate 20-credit co-requisite (10 literacy + 10 numeracy) whose credits do NOT count towards the 60. Older sources still say '80 credits' - that was the pre-2024 rule (80 total, 60 at level + 20 carried) and is why the project spec flagged a 60/80 conflict. The co-requisite is met once and then counts for every level.
note.zh: 2026-09-29 对照 NZQA「NCEA levels and certificates」核实。2024 起每级需该级或以上的 60 学分，**另加**独立的 20 学分 co-requisite（读写 10 + 算术 10），其学分**不计入** 60。旧资料仍写「80 学分」——那是 2024 前的规则（共 80，其中 60 在本级 + 20 可来自低一级），这正是规格标注的 60/80 分歧来源。co-requisite 一次修得，对各级均有效。

note.en: 10 Literacy or Te Reo Matatini credits and 10 Numeracy or Te Pāngarau credits. Met once, then counts for every NCEA level. These credits cannot also count towards the 60.
note.zh: 读写（或 Te Reo Matatini）10 学分 + 算术（或 Te Pāngarau）10 学分。一次修得即对各级 NCEA 有效；这些学分不能再计入 60 学分。

summary.en: 60 credits at any level (1, 2 or 3), plus the 20-credit co-requisite.
summary.zh: 任一等级（1、2 或 3）的 60 学分，外加 20 学分 co-requisite。

note.en: Quote: '60 credits at any Level (1, 2 or 3)'. carriedCreditsAllowed is 0 because Level 1 has no level below it to carry from.
note.zh: 官方原文：「60 credits at any Level (1, 2 or 3)」。carriedCreditsAllowed 为 0，因为 Level 1 之下没有可结转的等级。

note.en: Met once at any level; if already met for Level 1 it also counts here.
note.zh: 一次修得、各级通用；若在 Level 1 已满足，此处同样有效。

summary.en: 60 credits at Level 2 or above, plus the 20-credit co-requisite.
summary.zh: Level 2 或以上的 60 学分，外加 20 学分 co-requisite。

note.en: Quote: '60 credits at Level 2 or above'. The pre-2024 '20 credits from a lower level' allowance is NOT part of the current 60-credit rule, so carriedCreditsAllowed is 0.
note.zh: 官方原文：「60 credits at Level 2 or above」。2024 前「可含 20 个低一级学分」的规定**不属于**现行 60 学分规则，故 carriedCreditsAllowed 为 0。

note.en: Met once at any level; if already met earlier it also counts here.
note.zh: 一次修得、各级通用；若此前已满足，此处同样有效。

summary.en: 60 credits at Level 3 or above, plus the 20-credit co-requisite.
summary.zh: Level 3 或以上的 60 学分，外加 20 学分 co-requisite。

note.en: Quote: '60 credits at Level 3 or above'.
note.zh: 官方原文：「60 credits at Level 3 or above」。
